gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Commanding in its huge lowercase eye, Unica One hands off to Noto Sans Tai Le, whose ink strokes taper away. Blunt and gentle sit together, the first shouting, the second easing in.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Unica One stamps out commanding headings with uniform, nozzle-pulled strokes and daylight-filled curves. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement does the quieter job, with round forms like open parentheses and a tall middle band that looks stocky.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: A very large lowercase eye and daylight in every curve define Unica One, which hands off to Noto Sans Thai Looped. One shouts, the other speaks sturdily, with spacious gaps at its curve ends.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Stroke-for-stroke uniform and loud, Unica One lets its huge lowercase eye breathe. Noto Sans Tirhuta takes over with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, a plain sans that fills the line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-vai: Blunt and confident, Unica One never swells mid-curve, daylight in every bowl. Noto Sans Vai brings words that read as solid blocks, with generous space where the curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Loud and uniform, Unica One is hard to miss. Noto Sans Vithkuqi then reads smoothly over many lines, its a, c, e and s keeping open throats and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Stamped and heavy, Unica One cuts strokes like a fixed-width router bit while Noto Sans Wancho hulks in chalky lowercase. Over a full page it stays chunky, each e gaping at its terminal.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Commanding from the first letter, Unica One keeps its strokes as constant as bent wire. Noto Sans Warang Citi handles the reading, with words that read as solid blocks and wide channels into each counter.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Distinctive in its constant-width arms and legs, Unica One makes a firm start before Noto Traditional Nushu. Across a whole page, that broad-nibbed sans keeps its bowls full and uncurled.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads with curves that never close back on themselves and lowercase nearly matching the capitals. And across a page it stays clean, while Unica One traces its strokes like a marker.
